source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-24

procedures.title: Distributor (breaker point type): clean and inspect
steps: ...make sure the weights fit freely on their pivot pins.
Check the cam for wear or roughness, and that it fits on the shaft end perfectly freely.
Clean dirty points and replace badly pitted ones (see Distributor Contact Points).
Test the condenser for series resistance, capacity and leakage or breakdown using the tester maker's instructions.
Inspect the cap and plug wires for damage and replace as needed.
notes: Figure 13i in the manual is an exploded view of the V8 distributor.
